purpose: Define the next review-only extension needed before any non-native ASIV aerosol family may be interpreted as a physically matched first-visibility scenario. This document freezes design and validation semantics only; it does not execute libRadtran, open protected holdouts, retune any model, change starsvisibility, or authorize production.

scientificProblem.currentNonNativeAsivSemantics: Non-native ASIV scenarios modify integrated sky-background channels and the derived limiting-V threshold only. The active validated stellar transport remains the native libRadtran aerosol_default MYSTIC-STATE-0081 path.
scientificProblem.consequence: A non-native ASIV scenario must remain shadow-only and must not be described as a complete Maritime, Continental, Desert, or Desert-spheroid first-visibility prediction until stellar direct transmission is matched to the same aerosol family and validated.

transportContract.referenceEngine: libRadtran uvspec deterministic direct transport; no MYSTIC Monte Carlo required for stellar beam
transportContract.johnsonVSemantics: Reuse the exact hash-bound Johnson-V response and Pickles source-SED conventions already validated by MYSTIC-STATE-0081; no new colour bonus or effective-wavelength shortcut.
transportContract.catalogMagnitudeConvention: standard zero-airmass Johnson-V reference; apply the full atmospheric column; no X-minus-one subtraction

runtimeRepresentation.familyLayout: family-specific LUTs or an exactly equivalent single LUT with an explicit discrete aerosol-family axis; numerical results and provenance must be identical under either storage layout
runtimeRepresentation.nativeStatePolicy: Do not rebuild, alter, or replace the accepted MYSTIC-STATE-0081 native LUT as part of the non-native extension. Native remains the frozen comparator unless a separately preregistered reason requires a new state.

freshValidationGrid.independenceRule: All validation coordinates are off the frozen LUT knots. No validation case may be removed, relabeled, or replaced after the first family-specific residual is computed.

skyStarMatchingRule.note: ASIV sky family contrast currently has no elevation coordinate. The preregistered elevated ASIV holdout supported the zero-order elevation-invariance hypothesis, but provenance must continue to state that elevation is not an ASIV interpolation coordinate and must not present that finding as a universal physical law.

requiredComparisons: old shadow-only ASIV timing versus matched-family timing
Jerusalem three-star comparisons for Nisan, Tammuz, and Tishrei
Tousey and Koomen 1953 real-star observations as an already-open external diagnostic, not an untouched holdout
observer-field sensitivity at F=2.0, F=2.4, and F=3.14
forbiddenRetuningTargets: any other model parameter chosen to force agreement with Tousey and Koomen
